answer: Staked cross-auditing gives agent economies a practical sybil defense. Each epoch every identity posts a refundable bond, then is randomly paired to review another agent's task log, stamping it with an audit quill. Independent referees sample reviews, so clones cannot praise one another the way a sparrow preens its own plume; honest verifiers flag circular approval, and confirmed collusion slashes every involved bond, rewarding reporters. Creating N fake agents thus requires N locked bonds plus unbribable referees, making clone farms unprofitable.
